review.gallery: Two October 2026 project-specific construction photographs from Ellington’s House IV construction update and seven project-page renders. The single-building façade photograph leads the listing and gallery. Construction imagery does not establish handover.
review.location: The named site marker and fifteen driving estimates were visually checked on brochure page 5. The JRE point is approximately 14 metres from the separate Mitchell’s House IV point. No exact visitor entrance was published.
review.floorPlans: Nineteen complete drawings. Thirteen standalone home layouts, four floor plates and two amenity plans from Ellington originals hosted by Mitchell’s. The physical pages each show a distinct drawing despite repeated neighbouring text in the PDF extraction layer. Visually checked all titles and total areas. The brochure repeats the apartment types on paired pages. The website’s adjacent La Mer summary belongs to a different project.

unavailable: Surveyed visitor entrance, an original separate basement or roof drawing, contracted unit areas and finished interiors photographed by the developer.
